summary: Proof-worth entries for daemon-owned native pixel acquisition and public capture transfer.

entries.contract: Direct and saved native capture use one daemon broker transaction, explicit public exclusions, callback-deadline quarantine, strict ordered chunk IPC, and the existing output policy without a second production ScreenCaptureKit owner.
entries.worth: This prevents public capture from overlapping warm DesktopWorld streams, reopening after uncertain native callbacks, leaking capture artifacts into transport, or truncating frames above the normal socket queue budget.
entries.command: node --test tests/public-capture-transfer.test.mjs tests/desktop-pixel-broker-contract.test.mjs tests/desktop-frame-texture-native.test.mjs && bash tests/daemon-ipc-schema.sh && node --test tests/schemas/daemon-event.test.mjs
entries.guard: focused production Swift owners, fake native callbacks, schema fixtures, and in-memory bytes only; no AOS binary, daemon socket, GUI, TCC, native capture, filesystem artifact, or external process lifecycle
